asset_set: Questionnaire Q26 option 1 — Building disaster-resistant housing

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: resilient, hopeful engineering — safety and craftsmanship, not disaster or damage
forbidden: collapsed building, rubble, or storm damage

riasec_accent.use: hurricane strap tips, tool-belt buckle, shirt cuff stripe

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, small smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — distinct build, skin tone and hairstyle from every other questionnaire character

pose.stance: full body, kneeling on one knee beside a workbench, three-quarter angle toward activity
pose.action: bolting a diagonal steel hurricane strap onto a small reinforced model house with a wrench, free hand steadying the roof ridge
pose.facing: 3/4 toward the model house, wrench hand forward

top.detail: dark charcoal collar, teal cuff stripe, rolled sleeve on wrench arm

subject.scene_narrative: A young man kneels beside a workbench, wrench in hand, fastening a diagonal steel hurricane strap onto the corner post of a small scale-model house while his other hand braces the roof ridge — the same full-body flat vector language as the approved Q1 references. Proactive craftsmanship, never disaster aftermath.
subject.hero_prop: small reinforced model house with light-wood frame, terracotta roof panel, and visible corner bracing
supporting_props: spirit level with lavender bubble vial
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey circles behind figure — no room interior

composition.layout: figure left-of-center kneeling, model house right at bench height, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of kneeling person + model house readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter R, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs, collapsed building, rubble, storm damage, industrial horror, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face. Young college-age man, athletic build, deep brown skin #7A4B32, short tight coils with faded sides, kneeling on one knee beside a workbench. He wears a purple #4B2C7F short-sleeve work shirt with charcoal collar and teal #4DB6AC cuff stripe, charcoal cargo pants with a tool belt, and dark work boots. He fastens a diagonal galvanized-steel hurricane strap (teal bolt caps) onto the corner post of a small light-wood model house with a terracotta roof panel, using a compact wrench, while his free hand steadies the roof ridge. A lavender #9575CD spirit level rests on the bench. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame. Mood: resilient, hopeful, capable structural engineering — never disaster or damage. Full head-to-feet visible.
